---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

1. Split earthquakes into train/test
2. calculate best_lambda using only train_data
3. create the Box–Cox response
4. fit models
5. predict test data
6. inverse Box–Cox predictions
7. calculate RMSE in MMI units.


```{r}
# LIBRARIES
library(arrow)
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(lme4)
library(here)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggnewscale)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
```

```{r}
# LOAD DATA
data <- read_parquet(
  here(
    "data_processed",
    "NZ_FR_IAR_final_dataset.parquet"
  )
)

# CHECK DATA
expected_columns <- c(
  "publicid",
  "cell_id",
  "origintime",
  "event_longitude",
  "event_latitude",
  "event_depth_km",
  "report_longitude",
  "report_latitude",
  "reported_mmi",
  "report_count",
  "Mw",
  "Repi_km",
  "Rhypo_km",
  "Vs30_m_s"
)

# Check all expected columns are present
stopifnot(
  all(expected_columns %in% names(data))
)

# Check earthquake-cell combinations are unique
stopifnot(
  nrow(data) ==
    nrow(
      distinct(
        data,
        publicid,
        cell_id
      )
    )
)

# Check important values are usable
stopifnot(
  all(data$report_count >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$Rhypo_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$Repi_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$event_depth_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$reported_mmi > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Confirm existing earthquake selection rules
stopifnot(
  all(
    data$origintime >=
      as.POSIXct(
        "2016-09-01",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
  ),
  all(
    data$Mw >= 3.5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

# Check earthquake-level attributes are consistent
event_check <- data |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  summarise(
    n_origintime = n_distinct(origintime),
    n_event_longitude = n_distinct(event_longitude),
    n_event_latitude = n_distinct(event_latitude),
    n_event_depth = n_distinct(event_depth_km),
    n_Mw = n_distinct(Mw),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(event_check$n_origintime == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_longitude == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_latitude == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_depth == 1),
  all(event_check$n_Mw == 1)
)

# REPORT COUNT FILTERING
minimum_reports_per_cell <- 4

# EARTHQUAKE THRESHOLDS
minimum_reports_per_earthquake <- 4


data_sd <- data |>
  filter(report_count >= minimum_reports_per_cell) |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  mutate(
    total_reports = sum(report_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  filter(total_reports >= minimum_reports_per_earthquake) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(
    if_all(
      c(
        publicid,
        cell_id,
        reported_mmi,
        Mw,
        event_depth_km,
        Repi_km,
        Vs30_m_s
      ),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    ),
    Repi_km > 0,
    Vs30_m_s > 0,
    reported_mmi >= 3
  )

# CHECK LOG TRANSFORMATIONS
stopifnot(
  all(
    data_sd$Repi_km > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  all(
    data_sd$Vs30_m_s > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

# 80 / 20 TRAIN-TEST SPLIT BY EARTHQUAKE
set.seed(123)


# Get unique earthquakes
earthquake_ids <- unique(
  data_sd$publicid
)


# Randomly select 80% of earthquakes for training
train_ids <- sample(
  earthquake_ids,
  size = floor(
    0.8 * length(earthquake_ids)
  )
)

# Split data by earthquake
train_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(
    publicid %in% train_ids
  )


test_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(
    !publicid %in% train_ids
  )

# Check split
cat(
  "Training earthquakes:",
  n_distinct(train_data$publicid),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Testing earthquakes:",
  n_distinct(test_data$publicid),
  "\n"
)


# BOX-COX FUNCTIONS
boxcox_transform <- function(
  y,
  lambda,
  tol = 1e-8
) {

  if (any(y <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Box-Cox transformation requires positive response values."
    )
  }

  if (abs(lambda) < tol) {

    log(y)

  } else {

    (y^lambda - 1) / lambda

  }
}


inverse_boxcox <- function(
  z,
  lambda,
  tol = 1e-8
) {

  if (abs(lambda) < tol) {
    return(
      exp(z)
    )
  }

  inside <- 1 + lambda * z

  result <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(z)
  )

  valid <- is.finite(inside) & inside > 0

  result[valid] <-
    inside[valid]^(1 / lambda)

  if (any(!valid)) {

    warning(
      "Some Box-Cox predictions could not be back-transformed."
    )

  }

  return(result)
}

# CREATE 5 CROSS-VALIDATION FOLDS
set.seed(123)

k <- 5


# Get unique TRAINING earthquakes
cv_earthquakes <- unique(
  train_data$publicid
)


# Randomly assign whole earthquakes to folds
fold_assignment <- tibble(
  publicid = sample(
    cv_earthquakes
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    fold = rep(
      1:k,
      length.out = n()
    )
  )


# Add fold number to each cell
train_cv <- train_data |>
  left_join(
    fold_assignment,
    by = "publicid"
  )


# Check number of earthquakes in each fold
fold_assignment |>
  count(fold)

# LINEAR MODEL CROSS-VALIDATION
cv_lr_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Linear model CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # # Find Box-Cox lambda using ONLY fold training data
  # bc_fit <- lm(
  #   reported_mmi ~
  #     event_depth_km +
  #     Mw +
  #     Repi_km +
  #     Vs30_m_s,
  #   data = fold_train
  # )
  # 
  # 
  # bc <- MASS::boxcox(
  #   bc_fit,
  #   plotit = FALSE
  # )
  # 
  # 
  # fold_lambda <- bc$x[
  #   which.max(bc$y)
  # ]

  # # Transform response
  # fold_train <- fold_train |>
  #   mutate(
  #     reported_mmi_bc =
  #       boxcox_transform(
  #         reported_mmi,
  #         fold_lambda
  #       )
  #   )

  # Model 1
  # Linear Repi + linear Vs30
  model_1 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 2
  # Log Repi + linear Vs30
  model_2 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 3
  # Linear Repi + log Vs30
  model_3 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 4
  # Log Repi + log Vs30
  model_4 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 5
  # Linear + log Repi + linear Vs30
  model_5 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 6
  # Linear + log Repi + log Vs30
  model_6 <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )


  models <- list(

    "Linear Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_1,

    "Log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_2,

    "Linear Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_3,

    "Log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_4,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_5,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_6

  )

# Predict validation earthquakes
for (model_name in names(models)) {

  pred_mmi <- predict(
    models[[model_name]],
    newdata = fold_validation
  )
  
    # Calculate RMSE
    rmse <- sqrt(
      mean(
        (
          fold_validation$reported_mmi -
            pred_mmi
        )^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )


  cv_lr_results <- bind_rows(
    cv_lr_results,
    tibble(
      fold = i,
      model = model_name,
      RMSE = rmse
      )
    )

  }

}

# LINEAR MODEL CV RESULTS
cv_lr_summary <- cv_lr_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_RMSE)


print(
  cv_lr_results
)

print(
  cv_lr_summary
)

# MIXED MODEL CROSS-VALIDATION
cv_mixed_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Mixed model CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # Model 1
  # Linear Repi + linear Vs30
  mixed_1 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + Repi_km | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Model 2
  # Log Repi + linear Vs30
  mixed_2 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Model 3
  # Linear + log Repi + log Vs30
  mixed_3 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s) +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )


  mixed_models <- list(

    "Linear Repi + linear Vs30" =
      mixed_1,

    "Log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      mixed_2,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      mixed_3

  )

  # Predict unseen earthquakes
  for (model_name in names(mixed_models)) {

    pred <- predict(
      mixed_models[[model_name]],
      newdata = fold_validation,
      re.form = NA,
      allow.new.levels = TRUE
    )


    # RMSE
    rmse <- sqrt(
      mean(
        (
          fold_validation$reported_mmi -
            pred
        )^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )


    cv_mixed_results <- bind_rows(
      cv_mixed_results,
      tibble(
        fold = i,
        model = model_name,
        RMSE = rmse
      )
    )

  }

}

# MIXED MODEL CV RESULTS
cv_mixed_summary <- cv_mixed_results |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_RMSE)


print(
  cv_mixed_results
)

print(
  cv_mixed_summary
)


# RESPONSE TRANSFORMATION CROSS-VALIDATION

# Compare:
#   1. Raw MMI
#   2. Log MMI
#   3. Box-Cox MMI

# Predictor structure is kept the same.
cv_transform_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Transformation CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # Find Box-Cox lambda from fold training data
  bc_fit <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )


  bc <- MASS::boxcox(
    bc_fit,
    plotit = FALSE
  )


  fold_lambda <- bc$x[
    which.max(bc$y)
  ]


  fold_train <- fold_train |>
    mutate(
      reported_mmi_bc =
        boxcox_transform(
          reported_mmi,
          fold_lambda
        )
    )

  # Raw MMI model
  model_raw <- lm(
  reported_mmi ~
    event_depth_km +
    Mw +
    Repi_km +
    log10(Repi_km) +
    Vs30_m_s,
  data = fold_train
)

  # Log MMI model
  model_log <- lm(
    log(reported_mmi)  ~
    event_depth_km +
    Mw +
    Repi_km +
    log10(Repi_km) +
    Vs30_m_s,
  data = fold_train
  )

  # Box-Cox MMI model
  model_bc <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Raw predictions
  pred_raw <- predict(
    model_raw,
    newdata = fold_validation
  )

  # Log predictions
  # Back-transform with exp()
  pred_log <- exp(
    predict(
      model_log,
      newdata = fold_validation
    )
  )

  # Box-Cox predictions
  pred_bc_transformed <- predict(
    model_bc,
    newdata = fold_validation
  )


  pred_bc <- inverse_boxcox(
    pred_bc_transformed,
    fold_lambda
  )

  # RMSE
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_raw
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  rmse_log <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_log
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  rmse_bc <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_bc
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  # Save results
  cv_transform_results <- bind_rows(
    cv_transform_results,

    tibble(
      fold = i,
      transformation = c(
        "Raw MMI",
        "Log MMI",
        "Box-Cox MMI"
      ),
      lambda = c(
        NA,
        NA,
        fold_lambda
      ),
      RMSE = c(
        rmse_raw,
        rmse_log,
        rmse_bc
      )
    )
  )

}

# TRANSFORMATION CV RESULTS
cv_transform_summary <-
  cv_transform_results |>
  group_by(transformation) |>
  summarise(
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    sd_RMSE = sd(RMSE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_RMSE)


print(
  cv_transform_results
)

print(
  cv_transform_summary
)

# FINAL BOX-COX LAMBDA

# Now that CV is finished, calculate lambda using ALL
# training data.
bc_final <- MASS::boxcox(
  lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = train_data
  ),
  plotit = FALSE
)


best_lambda_final <- bc_final$x[
  which.max(bc_final$y)
]


cat(
  "Final Box-Cox lambda:",
  best_lambda_final,
  "\n"
)


# Transform training response
train_data <- train_data |>
  mutate(
    reported_mmi_bc_final =
      boxcox_transform(
        reported_mmi,
        best_lambda_final
      )
  )

# FINAL LINEAR MODEL

# Uses Model 5: linear and log10 epicentral distance, with linear Vs30.
final_lm <- lm(
  reported_mmi ~
    event_depth_km +
    Mw +
    Repi_km +
    log10(Repi_km) +
   Vs30_m_s,
  data = train_data
)


summary(
  final_lm
)

# COEFFICIENT TABLE WITH CLUSTER-ROBUST STANDARD ERRORS

# 1. Calculate cluster-robust covariance matrix
# Group observations by earthquake (publicid)
cluster_vcov <- vcovCL(
  final_lm,
  cluster = train_data$publicid,
  type = "HC1"
)

# 2. Extract coefficient estimates and robust standard errors
coefficient_results <- coeftest(
  final_lm,
  vcov. = cluster_vcov,
  df = Inf
)

# 3. Calculate 95% confidence intervals
coefficient_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(coefficient_results),
  Estimate = coefficient_results[, 1],
  Robust_SE = coefficient_results[, 2],
  CI_lower = coefficient_results[, 1] -
    1.96 * coefficient_results[, 2],
  CI_upper = coefficient_results[, 1] +
    1.96 * coefficient_results[, 2],
  p_value = coefficient_results[, 4]
) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 4)
    )
  )

# 4. Display results
print(coefficient_table, row.names = FALSE)

# FINAL MIXED MODEL

# This currently uses:
# log10(Repi) + linear Vs30 + random intercept/slope.
final_mixed <- lmer(
  reported_mmi ~
    event_depth_km +
    Mw +
    log10(Repi_km) +
    Vs30_m_s +
    (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
  data = train_data,
  REML = FALSE
)


summary(
  final_mixed
)


# Check whether mixed model is singular
isSingular(
  final_mixed
)

# FINAL TEST DATA EVALUATION

# Linear model predicts directly in MMI units
pred_lm <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = test_data
)

pred_mixed <- predict(
  final_mixed,
  newdata = test_data,
  re.form = NA,
  allow.new.levels = TRUE
)

# Calculate RMSE
rmse_lm <- sqrt(mean(
  (test_data$reported_mmi - pred_lm)^2
))

rmse_mixed <- sqrt(mean(
  (test_data$reported_mmi - pred_mixed)^2
))

# Compare models
final_results <- tibble(
  Model = c("Linear model", "Mixed-effects model"),
  RMSE = c(rmse_lm, rmse_mixed)
) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

print(final_results)
```

```{r}
# PREDICTION PERFORMANCE BY MMI LEVEL

# Predict MMI on the test dataset
pred_mmi <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = test_data
)

# Create evaluation dataset
results <- test_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted_mmi = pred_mmi,
    error = predicted_mmi - reported_mmi,
    absolute_error = abs(error),
    squared_error = error^2,

    # Group observations by observed MMI category
    mmi_category = floor(reported_mmi + 0.5)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(predicted_mmi),
    !is.na(reported_mmi)
  )


# 1. OVERALL PERFORMANCE
overall_results <- results |>
  summarise(
    MAE = mean(absolute_error),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(squared_error))
  )

print(overall_results)


# 2. PERFORMANCE BY OBSERVED MMI
mmi_results <- results |>
  group_by(mmi_category) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    MAE = mean(absolute_error),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(squared_error)),
    mean_error = mean(error),
    'underpredicted(%)' = mean(error < 0) * 100,
    'overpredicted(%)' = mean(error > 0) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mmi_category)

print(mmi_results)


# 3. MACRO-AVERAGED MAE
# Gives each observed MMI category equal weight
macro_mae <- mmi_results |>
  filter(mmi_category %in% 3:8) |>
  summarise(
    macro_MAE = mean(MAE)
  )

print(macro_mae)


# 4. PLOT ERROR BY OBSERVED MMI
ggplot(
  mmi_results,
  aes(
    x = factor(mmi_category),
    y = mean_error
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction Error by Observed MMI",
    x = "Observed MMI",
    y = "Mean Prediction Error (MMI)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# TABLE 3: MMI DISTRIBUTION

table3 <- bind_rows(
  train_data |> mutate(dataset = "Training"),
  test_data |> mutate(dataset = "Testing")
) |>
  count(reported_mmi, dataset) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = dataset,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Total = Training + Testing
  ) |>
  select(
    MMI = reported_mmi,
    Total,
    Training,
    Testing
  ) |>
  arrange(MMI)

table3 <- bind_rows(
  table3,
  table3 |>
    summarise(
      MMI = NA_real_,
      across(-MMI, sum)
    )
)

print(table3, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# BASELINE MODEL COMPARISON

actual <- test_data$reported_mmi

baseline_mean <- rep(
  mean(train_data$reported_mmi),
  length(actual)
)

baseline_four <- rep(4, length(actual))

evaluate <- function(predicted) {
  c(
    MAE = mean(abs(predicted - actual)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((predicted - actual)^2))
  )
}

baseline_results <- rbind(
  "Training mean baseline" = evaluate(baseline_mean),
  "MMI 4 baseline" = evaluate(baseline_four),
  "Linear regression" = evaluate(pred_lm)
)

print(baseline_results)
```
```{r}
# Data actually used to fit the final model
model_data <- model.frame(final_lm)

# Full model
full_model <- final_lm

# Models excluding one predictor group at a time
reduced_models <- list(
  "Epicentral distance" = update(
    full_model, . ~ . - Repi_km - log10(Repi_km)
  ),
  "Magnitude (Mw)" = update(
    full_model, . ~ . - Mw
  ),
  "Depth" = update(
    full_model, . ~ . - event_depth_km
  ),
  "Vs30" = update(
    full_model, . ~ . - Vs30_m_s
  )
)

# Calculate importance
importance <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(reduced_models),
  Partial_R2 = sapply(reduced_models, function(m) {
    (deviance(m) - deviance(full_model)) / deviance(m)
  })
)

importance <- importance |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Partial_R2 = round(Partial_R2, 4)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Partial_R2))

print(importance)
```

```{r}
# MAP OBSERVED AND PREDICTED MMI FOR ONE EARTHQUAKE

# Choose earthquake
earthquake_id <- "2023p122368"

# GET EARTHQUAKE DATA
eq_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(publicid == earthquake_id)


# Check earthquake exists
stopifnot(
  nrow(eq_data) > 0
)

# PREDICT MMI AT ACTUAL FELT RAPID LOCATIONS

# Predict MMI directly at Felt RAPID locations
eq_data$predicted_mmi <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = eq_data
)

# CONVERT FELT RAPID LOCATIONS TO SPATIAL POINTS
eq_sf <- eq_data |>
  mutate(
    observed_mmi_category = factor(
      floor(reported_mmi + 0.5),
      levels = 3:8
    )
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "report_longitude",
      "report_latitude"
    ),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  st_transform(2193)

# EARTHQUAKE EPICENTRE
earthquake <- eq_data |>
  slice(1) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "event_longitude",
      "event_latitude"
    ),
    crs = 4326
  ) |>
  st_transform(2193)

# NZ MAP
nz_nztm <- nzmap |>
  st_transform(2193)

# Remove the Chatham Islands from the map
# Keep only the mainland New Zealand region
mainland_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = 1000000,
    ymin = 4700000,
    xmax = 2100000,
    ymax = 6300000
  ),
  crs = st_crs(2193)
)

nz_nztm <- st_crop(
  nz_nztm,
  mainland_bbox
)

# GET NEW ZEALAND MAP BOUNDARIES
nz_bbox <- st_bbox(nz_nztm)

# Add a margin around New Zealand
x_margin <- (nz_bbox["xmax"] - nz_bbox["xmin"]) * 0.20
y_margin <- (nz_bbox["ymax"] - nz_bbox["ymin"]) * 0.10

# Get coordinates from NZ map
nz_coords <- nz_nztm |>
  st_geometry() |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  st_coordinates()

# Find southernmost point
south_point_coords <- nz_coords[
  which.min(nz_coords[, "Y"]),
  c("X", "Y")
]

# Find southernmost point
south_point_coords <- nz_coords[
  which.min(nz_coords[, "Y"]),
  c("X", "Y")
]

# Convert to spatial point
south_point <- st_sfc(
  st_point(south_point_coords),
  crs = 2193
)

# Distance from earthquake epicentre to southern point
max_radius_km <- as.numeric(
  st_distance(
    st_geometry(earthquake),
    south_point
  )
) / 1000

# EARTHQUAKE VALUES
mw_value <- eq_data$Mw[1]

depth <- eq_data$event_depth_km[1]


# Hold Vs30 constant so predicted regions are circular
vs30_value <- median(
  eq_data$Vs30_m_s,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# GENERATE PREDICTIONS OVER EPICENTRAL DISTANCE

max_distance <- max_radius_km

prediction_data <- tibble(

  Repi_km = seq(
    from = 0.1,
    to = max_distance,
    by = 0.1
  ),

  event_depth_km = depth,

  Mw = mw_value,

  Vs30_m_s = vs30_value

)

# PREDICT MMI

# Predict raw MMI
prediction_data$predicted_mmi <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = prediction_data
)

# PREDICTION RANGE
minimum_predicted <- min(
  prediction_data$predicted_mmi,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


maximum_predicted <- max(
  prediction_data$predicted_mmi,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


print(
  c(
    minimum_predicted = minimum_predicted,
    maximum_predicted = maximum_predicted
  )
)

# MMI CATEGORY BOUNDARIES
mmi_boundaries <- seq(
  2.5,
  7.5,
  by = 1
)

mmi_boundaries <- mmi_boundaries[
  mmi_boundaries <= maximum_predicted
]

# FIND DISTANCE OF EACH MMI BOUNDARY
ring_distances <- map_dfr(
  mmi_boundaries,
  function(boundary) {

    closest <- prediction_data |>
      slice_min(
        abs(predicted_mmi - boundary),
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      )

    tibble(
      boundary = boundary,
      Repi_km = closest$Repi_km,
      predicted_mmi = closest$predicted_mmi
    )

  }
)


print(ring_distances)

# CREATE MMI RINGS
rings <- ring_distances |>
  mutate(
    radius_km = pmin(
      Repi_km,
      max_radius_km
    ),
    mmi = ceiling(boundary)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(radius_km))

# CREATE CIRCLE GEOMETRY
ring_geometry <- lapply(
  rings$radius_km,
  function(radius) {

    st_buffer(
      st_geometry(earthquake),
      dist = radius * 1000
    )[[1]]

  }
)


rings_sf <- st_sf(

  boundary = rings$boundary,

  radius_km = rings$radius_km,

  mmi = rings$mmi,

  geometry = st_sfc(
    ring_geometry,
    crs = 2193
  )

)

rings_sf$mmi <- factor(rings_sf$mmi, levels = 3:8)

# MMI COLOURS
mmi_colours <- c(
  "3" = "#BFCCFF",
  "4" = "#A0E6FF",
  "5" = "#80F5A0",
  "6" = "#FFFF00",
  "7" = "#FFC800",
  "8" = "#FF9100"
)

# CREATE MAP
mmi_map <- ggplot() +

  # NZ map
  geom_sf(
    data = nz_nztm,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  # Predicted MMI regions
  # Largest circles are plotted first
  geom_sf(
    data = rings_sf,
    aes(
      fill = mmi
    ),
    colour = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +

  # NZ boundaries drawn above predicted circles
  # Keeps New Zealand visible behind the circles
  geom_sf(
    data = nz_nztm,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # Observed MMI at Felt RAPID cells
  geom_sf(
    data = eq_sf,
    aes(fill = observed_mmi_category),
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.2,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.95,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Earthquake epicentre
  geom_sf(
    data = earthquake,
    shape = 4,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.5
  ) +

  # North arrow
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    which_north = "true",
    pad_x = unit(0.3, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.3, "in"),
    height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    style = north_arrow_minimal
  ) +
  
    # Scale bar
  annotation_scale(
    location = "br",
    width_hint = 0.25,
    unit_category = "metric",
    style = "bar",
    pad_x = unit(0.3, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.3, "in"),
    text_cex = 0.8,
    line_width = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = mmi_colours,
    limits = as.character(3:8),
    name = "MMI",
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Observed and Predicted Earthquake Intensity",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Earthquake: ", earthquake_id,
      " | Mw: ", round(mw_value, 2),
      " | Depth: ", round(depth, 1), " km"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  # Focus map on New Zealand
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(
      nz_bbox["xmin"] - x_margin,
      nz_bbox["xmax"] + x_margin
    ),
    ylim = c(
      nz_bbox["ymin"] - y_margin,
      nz_bbox["ymax"] + y_margin
    ),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# DISPLAY MAP
mmi_map

# Create earthquake_maps folder inside Project-Silvanus
dir.create(
  here("earthquake_maps"),
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Save map
ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "earthquake_maps",
    paste0("MMI_map_", earthquake_id, ".png")
  ),
  plot = mmi_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
